description: NaLa(SO₄)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.47-2.80 Å. La is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten O atoms. There are a spread of La-O bond distances ranging from 2.55-2.79 Å. There are two inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.48-1.51 Å. In the second S site, S is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.48-1.51 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one La, and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, one La, and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent La and one S atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Na, one La, and one S atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Na, one La, and one S atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, one La, and one S atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent La and one S atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one La, and one S atom.
